analysis.title: Nvidia Without Jensen? Lowering Target Price Again
key_insights: Citi cuts its NVDA target price to $225 from $285 and keeps the Buy rating. The new target is a 20% discount to the prior 19x P/E, applied because of increased uncertainty over the CEO's position.

Citi cites a Bloomberg report dated 11/11/26 that Nvidia's board is discussing the future of CEO Jensen Huang. The report says he is under investigation over a relationship with an Nvidia executive, and it adds to scrutiny from a previously reported relationship involving a suspected Chinese intelligence asset.
Citi says a leadership transition would create an overhang on the stock because of Huang's central role in strategy, product vision, customer relationships and investor confidence.
Citi believes CFO Colette Kress could serve as interim CEO while the board evaluates external candidates.
Citi keeps Buy because the stock trades at about 11x P/E, in line with its prior trough. At the $173.73 close on 11 Nov 26 the target implies 29.5% share price return and 30.1% total return.

Citi's earnings estimates are unchanged. Core EPS is $9.26E for FY2027, $15.17E for FY2028 and $19.98E for FY2029. FY2027 is slightly below First Call consensus of $9.30 and Visible Alpha consensus of $9.36.

market_movers.rationale: Target cut from $285 to $225, a 20% discount to the prior 19x P/E, on uncertainty around the CEO. Buy is kept because the stock trades at about 11x P/E, in line with its prior trough.

earnings_insights: FY2027 core EPS estimate is $9.26E (Q1 $1.87 actual, Q2 $2.22 actual, Q3 $2.44E, Q4 $2.74E), unchanged from the previous estimate. First Call consensus is $9.30 and Visible Alpha consensus is $9.36.

FY2028 core EPS estimate is $15.17E against First Call consensus of $15.84 and Visible Alpha consensus of $15.96. FY2029 core EPS estimate is $19.98E against consensus of $20.99 on both First Call and Visible Alpha.
FY2026 core EPS was $4.49 actual (Q1 $0.75, Q2 $0.98, Q3 $1.23, Q4 $1.55), against consensus of $4.77 on both First Call and Visible Alpha.
Revenue is forecast at $411.4B for FY2027E, $699.1B for FY2028E and $940.6B for FY2029E, with core EPS growth of 106.0%, 63.8% and 31.7%.

trade_ideas.description: Buy NVDA with a $225 target price (12-month basis, 29.5% expected share price return from $173.73)
trade_ideas.rationale: The stock trades at about 11x P/E, in line with its prior trough, even after the target multiple is cut for CEO uncertainty.
trade_ideas.risk: A forced CEO departure creating a leadership overhang. The report also lists competition in gaming, slower platform adoption, lumpiness in auto and data center markets, and cryptomining impact on gaming.

risk_factors: Leadership transition if Jensen Huang is forced out, given his central role in strategy, product vision, customer relationships and investor confidence.
Board discussion of the CEO's future after reported allegations of an investigation over a relationship with an Nvidia executive.
Competition in gaming could lower the stock if Nvidia loses market share.
Slower-than-expected adoption of new platforms could lower data center and gaming sales.
Lumpiness in auto and data center markets can add volatility to the stock and its multiple.
geopolitical: The report refers to a previously reported relationship involving a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, which adds to scrutiny of Nvidia's CEO.

tension_points.bear_case: A forced CEO departure would end an era and create an overhang on the stock given his central role in strategy, product vision, customer relationships and investor confidence. Citi cuts its target multiple by about 20% to reflect this.
